mainEntity.name: What is the process for staining a cabin interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The usual process starts with cleaning, light sanding or stripping where needed, and protecting nearby surfaces. After that, stain is applied in controlled coats, excess is wiped off, and a topcoat or sealer is added if the project calls for extra durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most cabin interior staining jobs include cleaning, prep, stain application, and sealing. Good prep matters most because it helps the color apply evenly and improves long-term durability.
